description_en: Deletes a specified rule in Web Application Firewall (WAF). This operation also deletes the configurations and conditions associated with the rule
description_zh: 该接口用于删除Web应用防火墙（WAF）中的指定规则，此操作将删除与该规则相关联的配置和条件
name: DeleteWafRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. If configuration version management is enabled, this parameter specifies the site version to which the configuration applies. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the WAF rule. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878257.html operation
parameters.help_zh: WAF规则的ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878257.html接口获取
parameters.name: id
